general.title: Uploads
general.description: Uploaded files from contact form and products

list.intro: Files from the contact form and from products with file upload. They are stored protected in the shop and can only be accessed here and in the respective order.
list.retention: Expired files are deleted automatically every day – retention periods under Extensions → Nova Upload → Configure.
list.search: Search: file name, customer, e-mail, subject, product or order number …
